options.name: switch
options.description: List of switch attributes. All writable attributes supported by BSN REST API with - replaced with _. Some examples are - user_friendly_name - switch name in string - fabric_user_friendly_name - fabric name in string - banner - login banner in string - domain_id - set the domain id of the switch

options.name: throttle
options.description: Throttling delay in seconds. Enables second retry on first failure.

options.name: timeout
options.description: REST timeout in seconds for operations that take longer than FOS default value.

options.name: vfid
options.description: VFID of the switch. Use -1 for FOS without VF enabled or AG.
